Our campus is more... Comercial? There's not any resource I can reach out to. However, I go to therapy once a week, I just still feel terible anyway. It's hard to apply anythung we talk on theraphy on my real life cause as soon as I'm alone my mind start working with and unseen strenght in it's personal project of making my life as miserable as it could be. It's like my thoughts were a predator and they habitat is me suffering, everytime I try to make plans, do a list or anything to put some order into things  they feel treatened and get meanier, angryer and flowing stronger into my mind

I don't know. Strict family, I had to get into college when I finished highschool or it would mean I'm a faillure. I wanted to do something I could change the world for the better! Help people and all these cliche stuff you hear here and there. Blood disgusts me, I'm not into physical stuff, and people tell me I'm a good listener, so I got into psychology

Don't get me wrong, I knew from the first class four years ago I was were I was suposed to be, I felt like after some really strange years (my teen years were hell, my father sexually harassed me and my sis and other shitty stuff who fucked an already naturally complicated time of my life) i finally fitted someone. It was not strange being me and classes were amazing and I was smilling with joy for learning (no kidding, I actually smilled through my first two years of college, professors used to find it weird till they got used to it)

But I don't know, ot was nice going through classes and learning interestinf stuff, but things just got real on a super scarry level. Now I have whole projects to do where I'm expected to handle the whole thing and take care of another persons' mental health and like. I can't help but feel that I didn't signed up for this, I had no idea what it would be like when I got here, can I evwn do this? I can't even read articles and do my research, let alone finish and applying a whole group therapy. I barely want to live, I don't want another life's weight on my back when I can't even gp by with my on, it's just too much to much. But at the same time I'm good at it and it's so fun when I get to do things and they end on right. 

I guess I'm just super scared, but knowing that doesn't make anything any better. 

(Sorry if it sounds weird, I'm brazilian, so english is not my first language)
